name: piwin-knowledge
description: Standalone Pi extension & MCP server for FSRS flashcards, local folder RAG retrieval, and Canvas study decks.

scripts.build: pnpm -r run build && node -e "import('esbuild').then(async ({build}) => { await build({entryPoints:['packages/mcp-server/src/tools.ts'],bundle:true,platform:'node',format:'esm',target:'node22',minify:true,outfile:'dist/knowledge-runtime.mjs'}); await build({entryPoints:['packages/mcp-server/src/index.ts'],bundle:true,platform:'node',format:'esm',target:'node22',minify:true,outfile:'dist/mcp-server.mjs'}); })"
scripts.test: VITEST_MAX_FORKS=2 VITEST_MAX_THREADS=2 pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 -r run test && vitest run index.test.ts
